question: Should generic transient tool-progress intent become a supported public reply-payload plugin-SDK contract, or remain an internal producer-to-channel runtime fact?
rationale: The branch adds a reusable public constant and predicate beside an existing specialized fast-mode marker, and repository policy requires explicit ownership for plugin API expansion.

options.title: Keep Intent Internal
options.body: Carry a typed progress fact through internal runtime structures without adding a new external plugin-SDK contract.

options.title: Approve Public Contract
options.body: Retain the generic exported constant and predicate with explicit compatibility ownership, documentation, and focused public-surface tests.

recommendation.title: Keep Intent Internal
recommendation.body: Carry a typed progress fact through internal runtime structures without adding a new external plugin-SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work introduced the existing progress-kind seam and the current Slack code that must absorb this change.
